sections.title: Open today's assigned workout
sections.text: From Home, tap Preview session to review today's assigned workout.

sections.title: Review, then start
sections.text: Check the exercises and targets, then tap Start workout.

sections.title: Your active workout
sections.text: Your session includes editable weights, reps, and set logging.

sections.title: Return Home and scroll
sections.text: Return Home, then scroll down to Rest Day.

sections.title: Plan a recovery day
sections.text: Tap Rest Day when you need a recovery day.

sections.title: Take today off
sections.text: Set Today as Rest Day pauses training and moves your program forward.

sections.title: Keep your next workout
sections.text: Your workout moves to the next training day.

sections.title: Plan your regular rest days
sections.text: Open Rest Day again to plan repeating breaks.

sections.title: Open the rest-day planner
sections.text: Choose Plan Rest Day for your regular schedule.

sections.title: Pick repeating weekdays
sections.text: Under Every week, select the weekdays you want off.

sections.title: Repeat automatically
sections.text: Weekly rest days repeat automatically and save immediately.

sections.title: One-off dates are separate
sections.text: Use Add date for a one-off rest day.

target_timing: Existing video cues, with 0.12-second end pause
